text: Around the 35th minute, Kingsmoor FC successfully increased their momentum by leveraging their 4-4-2 wide, crossing approach, leading to 5 final third entries and a high xG of 1.24 within 8 minutes, indicating strong offensive pressure. Their ability to overload the flanks disrupted Westport Albion’s direct vertical passing, causing 3 turnovers and allowing Kingsmoor to maintain slightly better possession (51.7%) and pass accuracy (83.9%). However, despite creating multiple good chances including Felix Duarte’s big opportunity, they failed to convert, with no shots on target in the last 10 minutes. The key coaching point is to emphasize finishing under pressure to capitalize on the quality chances created through wide play.
